sources.title: AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies
sources.snippet: Guard models support the safe deployment of language model agents, but fixed risk taxonomies limit their ability to accommodate requirements that vary across applications and tasks. Under user-defined policies, detecting violations requires interpreting both the applicable rules and the agent's behavior, since identical actions can receive different judgments under different policies. sources.title: AdaGuard: An Adaptive Guard Model with User-defined Policies
sources.snippet: Through supervised initialization followed by SafePO, we develop AdaGuard, a family of 0.6B, 4B, and 8B guard models that assess agent trajectories under policies supplied at inference time.
